title: GARM Holdings Launches $5 Million Equity Raise to Expand Global Leadership in Regenerative Medicine | User | dailytimesleader.com
text:
Roatan, Western Caribbean - GARM Holdings Inc , a Delaware based corporation facilitating GARM expansions into other countries, is an established pioneer in cutting-edge regenerative medicine and longevity treatments, announces the launch of a $5 million equity raise. With over 11 years of profitability and a global reputation for excellence, the Global Alliance for Regenerative Medicine is uniquely positioned to expand its footprint through new clinic locations in top medical tourism hubs. Many of the company’s exclusive therapies are unavailable anywhere else in the world and are revolutionizing patient outcomes.
GARM’s groundbreaking work is featured in the 2025 Netflix documentary "Don't Die," led by longevity pioneer Bryan Johnson. Highlighting its pioneering role in the healthcare sector, the feature demonstrates GARM's commitment to innovation and improving the quality of life for patients worldwide.
“Our exclusive treatments and proven track record make GARM an unparalleled leader in the regenerative medicine and longevity fields,” said Heather Terry, CEO and co-founder of GARM. “This funding will allow us to further expand locations, and therefore, provide additional access for patients to these life-changing therapies and solidify our position at the forefront of the industry.”
Glenn C. Terry, M.D., GARM's co-founder and Chief Medical Officer, added, “Our mission is to offer transformative, safe, and effective solutions for patients who seek options other than or in addition to conventional surgical and/or pharmaceutical pathways. We are excited to bring our therapies to more people globally.”
GARM Holdings is advised by and represented by Jeweliet Tangen of TWM Finance. Please contact us at info@garmclinic.com for more information.
